business_problem: consolidate hundreds of terabytes of governed data and speed financial forecasting plus member insight workloads without the downtime and complexity of the prior stack.
solution_summary: WHOOP uses Snowflake, Snowpark, Cortex AI, and Streamlit on Snowflake to consolidate hundreds of terabytes of governed data and speed financial forecasting plus member insight workloads without the downtime and complexity of the prior stack. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so analysts, operators, and business teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. WHOOP achieved 3X Faster financial forecasting with new AI/ML model built using Snowpark.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Provides in-platform AI functions used for summarization, classification, generation, or model-assisted analysis.

solution_components.name: Streamlit
solution_components.role: Provides the user interface for analytics or AI applications backed by Snowflake data.

data_flow: application, customer, event, and operational data flow into Snowflake, Snowpark, Cortex AI, and Streamlit; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to analysts, operators, and business teams.
